fullDesc: On January 27, 1945 Soviet soldiers liberated Auschwitz-Birkenau in Poland. Over a million people, mostly Jews, had been murdered there. The date is now International Holocaust Remembrance Day.
realFacts: Only about 7,000 prisoners were found alive
The Nazis had tried to destroy evidence
Survivors' testimonies helped convict the guilty at Nuremberg
It is now a museum and memorial
